name: com.cwcbb.cwcscenedirector
displayName: CwcSceneDirector - Scene Content & AI Spawning Director
description: A high-performance, modular scene generation and AI spawning director system for Unity. Features Diablo IV-inspired quota shuffle & macro Poisson/FPS sampling, Risk of Rain 2-style credit-budget dynamic encounters with target lock & overdraft, 2.5D chunked spatial point cloud perception, and zero-allocation frame-budget time slicing.
